# Solution Runbooks

This generated delivery layer projects the catalog without moving its packages: canonical assets remain in [solutions/](../solutions/README.md). 30 of 51 catalog solutions have runbooks in this projection.

Regenerate with `python tools/build_solution_runbooks.py`; verify without writing with `python tools/build_solution_runbooks.py --check`. Add solutions one by one after their `solutions/runbook-notes/<slug>.json` notes validate. Explicit `--solution SLUG` or `--all` writes require authored notes for every selected package; all catalog solutions can still render in memory. Returning to the default write removes stale marker-owned files, never unmarked content.

**Package-folder rule:** `RUNBOOK_SOLUTIONS`, `--solution`, output folders and notes filenames use the package-folder slug. The notes `solution` field keeps the canonical catalog identity, and the index shows the catalog display name. For example, `production-line-optimization` uses `01-solutions/product-line-optimization/` and `solutions/runbook-notes/product-line-optimization.json`, with `"solution": "@aibast-agents-library/production-line-optimization"`.

Repository sources may cite an existing Markdown or HTML section as `path#anchor`; headings and explicit HTML anchors follow the shared GitHub-slug checker. Missing files or anchors fail validation.

## Artifact Anatomy

| Artifact | Delivery question |
| --- | --- |
| 0.Resources/README.md | Links to package assets, workshop pages, evidence, and exports |
| 1.Overview.md | Scenario, qualification, scope, users, and delivery risks |
| 2.Architecture.md | Flow, responsibilities, components, boundaries, and replacement seams |
| 3.Runbook.md | Build lanes, acceptance, recovery, and release checklist |
| 4.Sample-prompts.md | Persona prompts, expected evidence, routing, and prohibited behavior |
| 5.Acceptance-Evidence.md | Optional recorded evidence and screenshot inventory; not a new verdict |

The [registry](../registry.json) identifies each agent file; line counts use the actual source text, not registry `_lines`. Inventory counts use package files in Git's file universe: `manual/GLOBAL-INSTRUCTIONS.md`, `manual/knowledge/*.md`, and `manual/skills/*/SKILL.md`. The source-controlled `InlineAgentSkill` components represent the same skills and are not counted again. When manual knowledge is absent, count the Copilot Studio knowledge files excluding `.mcs.yml` metadata. Manual steps count frames in `screenshots/manual/browserfilm.json`, not successful or accepted actions.
